2026-10-08 08:51:48.005724 | controller | template units). This means they are not meant to be enabled or disabled using systemctl.
2026-10-08 08:51:48.005728 | controller |
2026-10-08 08:51:48.005733 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-10-08 08:51:48.005746 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-10-08 08:51:48.005750 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-10-08 08:51:48.005753 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-10-08 08:51:48.005761 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-10-08 08:51:48.005764 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
